description: This file handles outbound messaging functionalities including sending messages and polls, resolving channels and plugins, and interacting with message gateways in a messaging system.

methods.name: loadMessageConfigRuntime
methods.description: Loads the runtime configuration for message config.

methods.name: loadMessageGatewayRuntime
methods.description: Loads the runtime configuration for message gateway.

methods.name: buildMessagePollResult
methods.description: Constructs a MessagePollResult object from normalized input and optional result.

methods.name: resolveRequiredChannel
methods.description: Resolves the message channel, throws if not found.

methods.name: resolveRequiredPlugin
methods.description: Resolves the outbound plugin for a given channel, throws if unknown.

methods.name: resolveGatewayOptions
methods.description: Resolves and sanitizes gateway options, enforcing security constraints.

methods.name: callMessageGateway
methods.description: Calls the message gateway with specified method and parameters.

methods.name: resolveMessageConfig
methods.description: Resolves message configuration, loading defaults if necessary.

methods.name: resolveGatewayIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Generates or returns a provided idempotency key for gateway requests.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message via specified channel and gateway, supports dry run and payload normalization.

methods.name: sendPoll
methods.description: Sends a poll message via specified channel, supports normalization and dry run.
